newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P affirms Hutchison Whampoa ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Hutchison Whampoa ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it has affirmed the A-plus long-term local currency and single-A long-term foreign currency ratings of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd.
The affirmation follows Hutchison's announcement of a conditional general offer for Hongkong Electric Holdings as part of reorganisation of the Cheung Kong group, of which both companies are members.
S&P said the company's local currency outlook is stable, reflecting its strong portfolio of business and conservative financial profile.
The foreign currency outlook is positive, reflecting the foreign currency rating outlook for Hong Kong, S&P said.
Hutchison increased its stake in the utility to 35.01 percent last Friday, triggering a general offer.

S&P said that while Hutchison has yet to announce the precise method of financing the acquisition, given the narrow premium to the pre-offer share price, it expects a low level of acceptances with the total cost not likely to significantly raise Hutchison's new debt and gearing.
S&P said Hutchison's finances are strong, with net interest cover of more than nine times and net debt-to-capital at about 14 percent for year-end 1995.
